instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct conjunction.

atoms.b: She checked her emails ((++before or)) leaving the house.
He didn’t show up for our date, ((++nor because)) did he cancel.
He started cleaning the flat ((++after so)) all of his guests had left.
((++Since Yet)) I’m not busy today, I can help you with your chores.
